content: पिण्डित {%a.%} [पिण्ड्-क्त] .²1 Pressed or rolled into a ball or lump. .²2 Thick, lumpish. .²3 Heaped together, collected; एष पिण्डितार्थः <ls>M. 1</ls> ‘this is the meaning on the whole’. .²4 Mixed with; न समा मम वीर्यस्य शतांशेनापि पिण्डिताः <ls>Mb. 10. 12. 17</ls>. .²5 Added, multiplied. .²6 Counted, numbered. .{@-तः@} Incense.
